| `setPendingDestination(Tile tile)` | Set a pending tile as a target for the next walking call, if there is a discrepancy/misclick, it will automatically adjust your 'clicked' tile to this. |
| `toInstance(Tile tile)` | Attempts to turn a Tile from an instanced map area to the current dynamic region |
